title: Sharpify — AI Quote Writer for Contractors
company_summary: Sharpify is an AI-powered quote writing SaaS tool built for B2B service tradespeople including roofers, plumbers, electricians, landscapers, and other skilled trades workers. Generate professional branded quotes in 60 seconds.
goal_summary: Help tradespeople and B2B service workers win more jobs by sending fast, professional AI-generated quotes.

What they do: AI Quote Writer — generate branded quotes in 60 seconds using AI.
Built for B2B service tradespeople: roofers, plumbers, electricians, landscapers, builders.
Type one line about the job, get a full branded quote with materials, labor hours, and payment terms.
Used by 2,300+ contractors across 26 countries. Over €50M in quotes generated.
